body.label: Target
body.html: One adjacent enemy with an empty space adjacent to another enemy.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, move the target 1 unit into the chosen empty space and deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage to it.

surges.html: Also attack the second enemy with the same roll for 1 Bludgeoning Damage.

rider.title: Contingency - Reversal
rider.html: When either target voluntarily moves adjacent to you before your next turn, push that creature 1 unit away and make it Exposed.
